**Qwen3.8-27B** and **Muse Glimmer** (30B) are both open-weight reasoning models designed to fit on a single 24GB consumer GPU (such as an RTX 4090 or 5090) . Qwen3.8-27B leads across most reasoning, coding, and computer-use benchmarks, whereas Muse Glimmer offers faster time-to-first-token, lower API serving costs, and strong deep-reasoning accuracy .

***

### Core Specifications

| Feature / Metric | Alibaba Qwen3.8-27B | Meta Muse Glimmer |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Developer** | Alibaba Cloud  | Meta  |
| **Active Parameters** | ~27.8B  | ~30B  |
| **Native Context Window** | 256k / 262k tokens  | 131k tokens  |
| **License** | Apache 2.0  | Apache 2.0  |
| **Multimodal Support** | Yes (Vision/Text)  | Yes (Vision/Text)  |
| **SWE-Bench Pro** | 61.7%  | 51.2%–53.4%  |
| **Terminal-Bench 2.1** | 73.0%  | 51.7%  |
| **GPQA Diamond** | 89.2%  | 83.5%  |
| **OSWorld-Verified** | 84.3%  | 65.9%  |
| **Time-to-First-Token (TTFT)** | ~2.98 s  | ~0.80 s  |
| **API Cost (per M tokens)** | ~$0.43  | ~$0.23  |

***

### Key Strengths of Qwen3.8-27B

- **Agentic coding and terminal work:** It substantially outperforms Muse Glimmer on software engineering benchmarks (SWE-Bench Pro, Terminal-Bench, and OSWorld) .
- **Long-context capabilities:** With a native 256k context window, it achieves higher retrieval recall across large document repositories without dropping needle data .
- **General problem-solving:** It holds a consistent edge in high-difficulty academic benchmarks such as GPQA Diamond and Humanity's Last Exam .

***

### Key Strengths of Muse Glimmer

- **Inference latency and responsiveness:** Muse Glimmer demonstrates a significantly faster time-to-first-token and higher raw generation throughput in standard decoding setups .
- **Deep search accuracy:** On small suites of complex constraint puzzles, its extended reasoning budget allows it to resolve edge cases effectively .
- **Cost efficiency:** For API users, Muse Glimmer's blended token pricing is nearly half the cost of Qwen3.8-27B .

***

### Recommendation

- Choose **Qwen3.8-27B** if your primary use cases are autonomous coding, tool-calling agents, terminal automation, or long-context document analysis .
- Choose **Muse Glimmer** if you need lower inference latency, cheaper hosted API costs, or lighter memory overhead for interactive chat workflows .
